recommended.label: Default
recommended.description: The kernel's own scheduler; no sched_ext scheduler runs.

recommended.label: Cosmos
recommended.description: Lightweight, keeps tasks on their CPU while the system has room and switches to deadline scheduling under load.

recommended.label: LAVD
recommended.description: Latency-criticality aware virtual deadlines: measures how latency-sensitive each task is and schedules accordingly.

recommended.label: EEVDF
recommended.description: A port of the kernel's own EEVDF scheduler to sched_ext, for comparing the two.

recommended.label: Cake
recommended.description: Gaming responsiveness and general-purpose use: keeps runnable tasks from waiting while preserving cache locality.
